carpet.rule.StackAnything.name: Stack Anything
carpet.rule.StackAnything.desc: Allows /stack to change the max stack size of a specific item.
carpet.rule.MaxStackAnythingSize.name: Max Stack Anything Size
carpet.rule.MaxStackAnythingSize.desc: Limits the max stack size that /stack can set. Defaults to 64.
carpet.rule.MobsNoEquipmentDrop.name: Mobs Don't Drop Equipment
carpet.rule.MobsNoEquipmentDrop.desc: Prevents mobs from dropping their naturally spawned equipment.
carpet.rule.MobsNoSpear.name: Mobs Don't Spawn with Spears
carpet.rule.MobsNoSpear.desc: Prevents newly spawned mobs from holding spears.
carpet.rule.BucketTansOsidianToLava.name: Bucket Turns Obsidian to Lava
carpet.rule.BucketTansOsidianToLava.desc: Using an empty bucket on obsidian consumes the obsidian and gives a lava bucket.
carpet.rule.ObsidianToLavaRecipe.name: Obsidian to Lava Recipe
carpet.rule.ObsidianToLavaRecipe.desc: Enables a shapeless crafting recipe: empty bucket + obsidian -> lava bucket.
carpet.rule.QuickIceToWater.name: Quick Ice to Water
carpet.rule.QuickIceToWater.desc: When one hand holds a pickaxe and the other holds ice, placing the ice directly places water, consumes one ice, and damages the pickaxe. Silk Touch disables this.
carpet.rule.QuickITWCheck.name: Quick Ice to Water Check
carpet.rule.QuickITWCheck.desc: Requires the pickaxe name to contain "_water" for Quick Ice to Water to trigger.
carpet.rule.QuickPlaceObsidian.name: Quick Place Obsidian
carpet.rule.QuickPlaceObsidian.desc: When holding a lava bucket in the main hand and a water bucket in the offhand, right-clicking places obsidian and consumes one lava bucket. The water bucket is not consumed.
carpet.rule.HotTNT.name: Hot TNT
carpet.rule.HotTNT.desc: TNT explosion drops are automatically smelted when the dropped item has a furnace recipe. Compatible with Carpet-TIS tooledTNT.
carpet.rule.WaterproofRedstoneComponents: Levers, buttons, tripwire hooks, redstone torches, redstone dust, repeaters, and comparators are not washed away by flowing water.
carpet.rule.WaterproofCarpet.name: Waterproof Carpet
carpet.rule.WaterproofCarpet.desc: Carpets are not washed away by flowing water.
carpet.rule.AllowSharePermission.name: Allow Permission Sharing
carpet.rule.AllowSharePermission.desc: Allows guests to use commands that the host has allowed via /allow.
carpet.rule.ContainerCleaner.name: Container Cleaner
carpet.rule.ContainerCleaner.desc: Allows /cc to remove a specific item from specific container blocks in an area.
carpet.rule.FurnacesCleaner.name: Furnaces Cleaner
carpet.rule.FurnacesCleaner.desc: Allows /furnace to remove items that cannot be smelted or used as fuel from furnaces, blast furnaces, and smokers in an area.
carpet.rule.LitematicaPaster.name: Litematica Paster
carpet.rule.LitematicaPaster.desc: Enables the /paster command for collecting, pasting, and returning materials for the currently selected Litematica placement.
carpet.rule.NeverFull.name: Never Full
carpet.rule.NeverFull.desc: Allows players to eat food even when their hunger bar is full.
carpet.rule.PistonHarvestAmethyst.name: Piston Harvest Amethyst
carpet.rule.PistonHarvestAmethyst.desc: Makes pistons drop the amethyst cluster item instead of amethyst shards when they destroy an amethyst cluster.
